thesis: A warm-dark restaurant back-office console — dinner service 'at a glance' for a single Friday night. The Fancy kit worn as a working manager's screen: a fixed sidebar + topbar app shell over a KPI row, an hourly sales bar chart beside a labor-cost ring gauge, and a top-sellers table beside a live floor-status tile grid. One ember-orange accent on charcoal, mono numerics everywhere, medium-high density — data you'd actually run a shift from.

tokens.fg: #EBE3D8 primary · #B8AC98 secondary · #8A7E6C muted mono · #6E6252 faint axis
tokens.accent: #F97316 ember orange (with #9A3412 deep ember ramp) · #4ADE80 positive-delta green
tokens.fontMono: Geist Mono (var(--font-mono)) — every numeric: KPI values, clock, prices, axes, table counts
tokens.radius: 12px KPI tiles · 14px chart & list panels · 8px nav pills · 10px floor tiles
tokens.border: 1px #2E2820 hairline on every panel/tile; #241F16 softer row dividers inside lists
tokens.motion: Restrained: a 1.8s opacity/glow pulse on the live 'covers seated' dot; a 120ms lift on floor-tile hover; ECharts' own mount ease. Everything else is static.

layout: Fixed two-column app shell, full-bleed to the viewport. A 210px charcoal Sidebar (brand lozenge 'G', 5 icon nav items, service footer) sticks beside a flex main column. The main column carries a 54px sticky Navbar topbar (section title + live-covers pill + mono wall clock) over a 22px-padded body. Body rhythm = three stacked grids: a 4-up KPI row, a 1.5fr/1fr split (sales-by-hour bar + labor gauge with a turnover key/value list), and a 1fr/1fr split (top-sellers table + floor-status tile grid). Collapses to 2-up KPIs and single-column panels under 900px.

sections.name: Sidebar nav
sections.what: Brand lozenge ('G' orange gradient) + Griddle wordmark, 5 nav items (Tonight active, Orders, Menu, Staff, Reports) each with a lucide icon, and a mono service footer 'The Copper Fork · Fri · dinner service'. Active item is ember text on a #2A2318 pill; controlled active state so an agent could switch views.
sections.restyle: react-fancy <Sidebar> re-skinned via its data-react-fancy-sidebar / -item hooks: charcoal band, 210px, muted #9A8E7C items, ember-on-pill [data-active]. Icons are lucide LayoutDashboard/Receipt/Utensils/Users/BarChart3.

sections.name: Topbar
sections.what: Section title 'Tonight at a glance' on the left; on the right a live '42 covers seated' pill with a glowing pulsing orange dot and a mono wall clock '7:48 PM'. Clock + seated count are static props (never Date.now()).
sections.restyle: react-fancy <Navbar> flattened to a 54px hairline-bottom bar; the live pill is a <Badge variant=soft> stripped to transparent ember text with a CSS-animated dot; items forced visible at all widths.

sections.name: KPI row
sections.what: Four stat tiles: Sales tonight $8.4k (▲14% vs Fri avg, green), Covers 128 (42 seated now, muted), Avg check $66 (▲$4, green), Void % 1.2% (2 comps, muted). Uppercase label, big mono value, colored delta sub-line (green positive / muted neutral).
sections.restyle: four <Card variant=outlined padding=none> as warm-dark stat tiles — 12px radius, uppercase 11px label, 26px mono value, delta color from data (#4ADE80 / #8A7E6C).

sections.name: Sales by hour
sections.what: Panel titled 'Sales by hour' with a mono '$8,420' total and a 7-bar column chart across dinner hours 5p–11p, per-bar ember-intensity coloring peaking at 8p.
sections.restyle: <Card> panel wrapping a fancy-echarts <EChart> bar — single series, 7 categories, values [30,58,88,100,70,44,22], per-point itemStyle color ramp #5C2E10→#7C3A12→#9A3412→#F97316, rounded top caps, axis hidden but for the hour labels.

sections.name: Labor vs sales
sections.what: Panel with a 118px ring gauge at 26% (ember arc on a #2E2820 track, center read-out, a light target tick at 30%) beside a '26% labor cost · target 30%' caption, over a two-row key/value list (Avg table turn 62 min, Covers on books 88/120) with a slim covers-on-books meter.
sections.restyle: the mockup's hand-drawn SVG ring is replaced by an <EChart> full-circle gauge (value 26, progress orange, roundCap; a second slim gauge pointer marks the 30% target). 'Covers on books' is a restyled <Progress> bar (value 88 / max 120, ember fill on dark track).

sections.name: Top sellers tonight
sections.what: Panel listing 5 dishes, each row a dish name + mono count (×) + ember mono revenue (Dry-aged Ribeye 38× $1,710 … Chocolate Tart 41× $451).
sections.restyle: <Card> wrapping a <Table> flattened to a warm list: header hidden, transparent rows on #241F16 dividers, name in fg, count in muted mono, revenue in ember mono, right-aligned.

sections.name: Floor status
sections.what: Panel with a 4-column grid of 12 square table tiles colored by state (seated=orange, open=green, reserved=brown), each showing a mono table number + state label; a 3-swatch legend below. Tiles are a controlled array — click one to cycle its state, so an agent bridge could repaint the floor.
sections.restyle: hand-rolled aspect-ratio:1 tile grid (the one genuinely bespoke piece) where each tile is a button painted from a state→[bg,fg] map with a nested <Badge> state label; legend swatches + a controlled useState array keep it agent-repaintable.

palette.restyle: the app shell's left rail — charcoal 210px band, muted items, ember-on-#2A2318-pill active state via [data-active]; lucide glyph per item.
flattened to a 54px sticky topbar with a hairline bottom; brand = section title, items = live pill + mono clock, forced flex at every width.
every surface — KPI stat tiles (12px), chart & list panels (14px) — warm #1F1B16 on a #2E2820 hairline, header as a title/total row.
sales-by-hour columns with a per-point ember→orange itemStyle ramp, rounded caps, hidden y-axis, dark tooltip.
labor-cost ring — full-circle progress gauge, ember arc on a dark track, mono center read-out, plus a slim second-series pointer marking the 30% target.
top-sellers flattened to a headerless warm list — transparent rows, soft dividers, ember mono revenue column, right-aligned numerics.
two roles — the live 'covers seated' topbar pill (transparent ember + animated dot) and the per-tile floor state label (transparent, inherits the tile foreground).
the 'covers on books' meter — slim ember bar on a #2E2820 track under the turnover key/value list.
the footer colophon — mono uppercase heading + muted note crediting the restyled primitives.

contentArchetype: A single-snapshot operational dashboard: one Friday dinner service for a fictional restaurant ('The Copper Fork'). Real back-office data — sales totals, hourly revenue curve, labor-cost ratio vs target, table turn, covers on books, top-selling dishes with counts + revenue, and a live floor map of table states. Everything is one moment in time (7:48 PM), the kind of screen a manager glances at between courses.
remix: Swap the ember-on-charcoal palette for any single-accent-on-dark scheme and this becomes a generic ops console: rename the KPIs, repoint the hourly bar to any time series, and re-label the gauge (SLA %, utilization, error budget). The floor-tile grid generalizes to any status board — parking bays, server racks, delivery zones, seats — by changing the state→color map. Blend with a lighter dashboard blueprint for a day-shift theme, or add a Tabs view-switcher above the panels for Tonight / Week / Menu views.
